'''Lokka Fungus''' was a type of large [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] that grew on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref>[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> The fungus was used in [[totem magic]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] delivered the plant to [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] for use in magic. [[Logra/Legends|Logray]] tasked [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] with locating a Lokka spore when Teebo asked to be his apprentice. Teebo found a Lokka spore and dragged it through [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], finding it so heavy that he needed both hands to lift it. As he was struggling to get it up a staircase, he told his sister [[Malani]] that he needed to get it to Logray, but she told him that Logray's house was in the other direction, and that he was heading for their house. Teebo then tried to explain away his mistake by saying that he was taking a shortcut, but he briefly stepped away from the spore, which he had been holding with his back on the stair railings, and it then came loose and rolled down the stairs, before bouncing through the village into [[Logray's hut]], where it burst open, getting slime all over the hut. Teebo then entered the hut and nervously told Logray that he found the Lokka Spore he wanted, and Logray irritably told him to grab a broom and to clean the mess. Chief [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] then entered the hut and asked what happened, shocked by the mess, and Logray told him to ask his apprentice, causing Logray to congratulate Teebo, before Chirpa got his foot stuck on some of the slime from the Lokka spore. Teebo then accidentally waved a wand, which caused the slime and all the other parts of the Lokka spore to vanish, before Logray reprimanded him for completing the task without magic. Logray then told Teebo to finish cleaning the hut without magic, and he went to fetch a new Lokka Spore.<ref name="Sunstar" />

Logray later returned to the hut with a much smaller Lokka Spore, which he was able to hold in his hand. He entered the hut announcing to Teebo that he had found it, but Teebo had already left.<ref name="Sunstar" />
